start_container: start a single container instance for running an MPC game package with optional certificate and OPA workflow
start_containers: start multiple container instances in batch with shared env vars, timeout, and certificate request parameters
stop_containers: stop multiple running container instances by their instance IDs and return cancellation results
get_container: get a single container instance by its instance ID to check status and exit code
wait_for_pending_containers: async wait for multiple pending container instances to transition to a running state and emit insights
